run_scenario: run a gRPC client scenario on a channel and return an Outcome
create_Pipe: create a thread-safe iterator pipe that blocks until values are added
run_unary_unary: run a unary-unary gRPC call and compare the response to expected
run_stream_stream: run a stream-stream gRPC call by feeding requests through a Pipe
run_concurrent_stream_unary: run multiple concurrent stream-unary gRPC calls and verify all responses
